_meta.description: Lantern Learn's foundation source list. Every fact, standard and activity in a Lantern Learn, Rocket & Raven or Fox & Fern course is based on sources listed here (or added here before the content ships). Keys follow '{grade_id}_{subject_slug}'. Each key holds a list of sources. Pre-K has no Common Core alignment; those entries emphasize developmentally appropriate practice.
history: v1 (2026-06): Chris Brock, prek-5th x 6 subjects, 3 entries each, {title,url,description}; kept verbatim in standards/sources-v1-2026-06.json.

v2 (2026-10-12): rebuilt by scripts/build_sources.py; v1 entries kept, grade ids 6th_8th, 9th_12th, adult and six subjects added from the live courses, new columns, _courses and _open_resources added.

entry_fields.title: Page title.
entry_fields.kind: standards_body | government | museum_library | university | education_org | review (not yet judged authoritative)
entry_fields.frameworks: Standards frameworks it defines (CCSS-M, CCSS-ELA, NGSS, CSTA, AP, AI4K12, NAEYC DAP, NCSS C3).
entry_fields.reuse: fact_source (check facts, write our own text) | reuse (license lets us adapt; see _open_resources) | link_only | avoid
entry_fields.license: License when checked; null means not checked, so treat as fact_source only.
entry_fields.cited_by: Course slugs whose SOURCES.md cites this exact URL.
entry_fields.url_status: Result of the last link check.

rules: Base every course fact, standard code and activity on a source in this file. If a needed source is missing, add it here first (with its publisher and kind) in the same change.
Standards codes must come from a key whose frameworks list that standard family.
Copy or adapt material only when reuse is "reuse" and follow the license in _open_resources; otherwise write original text.
Prefer standards_body, then government and museum_library, then university, then education_org. A "review" source needs a better one before new content relies on it.
Never fabricate a source or URL. Open every URL before citing it.
_media lists every photo, sim or story a course reuses, with its credit and license. Add a reused item to the course SOURCES.md (table columns: where, facts, title, credit, URL) and rebuild.
